score_justifications.TSLP: Strong same-marker direct asthma associations in FinnGen, UKB and BBJ, with PheWAS-wide significant TPMI support (p=3.5e-7; not genome-wide p<5e-8).
score_justifications.IL33: Strong direct asthma associations for two markers in FinnGen and UKB; tested markers do not establish East Asian replication. rs1342326 is rare in BBJ and missing in TPMI.
score_justifications.IL1RL1: Intronic rs1420101 directly associated in FinnGen, UKB and BBJ; TPMI only nominal (p=.011). Nearby rs3771166 is at IL18R1 and cannot uniquely identify IL1RL1.

confidence: High for retrieved marker associations; moderate for target causality and cross-ancestry generalization.

warnings: Variant not found in FinnGen PheWAS API (HTTP 404).
